title: You may remember me as the guy who made the life-changing decision to officially…
author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
selftext:
**NOT quit his full-time job** and make the ultimate collector mania fishing game! 

  
I present to you Time Synchers, the side chick of video games. We don't want to be your main game, just the one you keep on a second monitor. You’re a secret agent who travels space, time and the multiverse to catch unique fish, upgrade gear, farm boss fights, grind rare variants, flex your loot and COLLECT, COLLECT, COLLECT! 

  
I put out the prototype about two weeks ago. The feedback was **EXTREMELY HARSH AND EXACTLY WHAT I NEEDED.** A few of you played for ten minutes and found things I’d been staring directly at for months. I took it seriously, made a bunch of changes, and now I need another round of honest playtesting for my Alpha release.

If you’ve got 10 minutes, please give it a shot and tell me where you got hooked or where you wanted to close the tab. You can either play as a guest (anonymously) or create an account and play in your browser at [timesynchers.com](http://timesynchers.com)

**AI disclosure**  
**Art:** Some  
**Code:** Some  
**Music/SFX:** All

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Brain_Crackd_Studios this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development. Saying you used AI isn't the same as explaining how. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: Sure, AI was used to vibe code this game for html aswell as turn all my ideas art work in more polished and refined assets. I mainly used Claude for coding and ChatGPT for alot of my visual directions.

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: Early development was Godot, and transferred most of that with help to html to make it a browser game as to be more accessible since its only a few MB's
